episodes.title: Code Zero
episodes.summary: On his first day, Detective Jin Hogae works jointly with firefighters to resolve a kidnapping case.

episodes.title: Code Two
episodes.summary: The first responders try to stop a suicide attempt, but the case turns out to be more complicated.

episodes.title: Code Yellow
episodes.summary: Hogae's house is said to be haunted. He and Dojin try to solve the mystery that lies in the ashes.

episodes.title: Code V30
episodes.summary: A driver is arrested after a hit-and-run accident of a child. A shocking truth awaits.

episodes.title: Code Black
episodes.summary: Hogae starts an undercover operation. He must stop a crisis that may result in mass casualties.

episodes.title: Code Red
episodes.summary: An unidentified body is found at the scene of a fire. An unlikely person is held as a suspect.

episodes.title: Code Blue
episodes.summary: Ho-gae identifies a new suspect, while the case becomes evermore ensnared in mystery.

episodes.title: Code Clear
episodes.summary: Ho-gae reinvestigates a murder case and gets help from Song Seol and Yoon Hong.

episodes.title: Code Pink
episodes.summary: Firefighters rush to save a teenage girl attempting suicide. Police find a body of a newborn baby.

episodes.title: Code Amber
episodes.summary: The first responders search for the father of the stillborn child. They then meet a strange patient.

episodes.title: Code 1
episodes.summary: Hogae misses Hyunseo by a second. He and Seol pursue the evasive kidnapper.

episodes.title: Code F63.1
episodes.summary: A series of fire incidents occur. Dojin suspects a chain arson and goes to see Hogae.

episodes.title: Code Orange
episodes.summary: A series of puzzling arson incidents occur on the streets of Taewon.

episodes.title: Code B
episodes.summary: A new wave of arson incidents occurs with two fires breaking out in different locations.

episodes.title: Code R98
episodes.summary: The first responders and the NFS cooperate to uncover clues to the serial arsonist.

episodes.title: Code Gray
episodes.summary: The arsonist's final plan gets revealed. Can Hogae save everyone from danger and catch the criminal?

episodes.title: Lapport Building
episodes.summary: Hogae rejoins the team for a murder case at Myeongpil's villa, and a brand new cooperation unfolds.

episodes.title: Salami Tactics
episodes.summary: In the city of Taewon, a series of arson cases continues to wreak havoc and cause fear among its residents.

episodes.title: Hot Zone
episodes.summary: An unidentified body is found after a brawl at a junkyard. A crisis arises during the autopsy.

episodes.title: Code Green
episodes.summary: Criminals plan to endanger the NFS building. Can the team safeguard the place?

episodes.title: Code Purple
episodes.summary: Organs are extracted from a living person. As the autopsy progresses, someone crosses Hogae's mind.

episodes.title: Trust Fall
episodes.summary: Hogae uncovers Ma Joongdo's murder and faces escalating danger as he nears the truth.

episodes.title: Overkill
episodes.summary: In the city of Taewon, a series of arson cases continues to wreak havoc and cause fear among its residents.

episodes.title: Dying Message
episodes.summary: In the city of Taewon, a series of arson cases continues to wreak havoc and cause fear among its residents.
